content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Crypto payment

A crypto payment gateway is a service that allows digital creators to accept cryptocurrency as payment for their products. Unlike traditional payment processors, these gateways operate on decentralized networks, ensuring that creators can receive payments without high fees or restrictive terms. This matters because conventional platforms often charge substantial fees, such as Gumroad's 10% on each sale, significantly cutting into a creator's earnings. By using a gateway like NOWPayments, which only takes a 0.5% fee, creators can keep more of their revenue, allowing them to reinvest and grow their business.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The infrastructure for a crypto payment gateway involves several key components. At its core, it uses a combination of hosting platforms, backend logic, and payment processing services. For example, creators can host their sales pages on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, while utilizing Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend processing. When a customer makes a purchase, the payment is processed in real-time via NOWPayments, ensuring instant delivery of digital products. This seamless integration means that creators retain complete control over their data and operations without relying on third-party platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where traditional payment processors are unavailable or heavily restricted. Countries like Nigeria, Kenya, and Venezuela often face challenges in accessing platforms like PayPal or Stripe, leaving creators unable to monetize their work. By utilizing a crypto payment gateway, these creators can tap into global markets without the barriers imposed by conventional payment systems. This approach empowers them to sell ebooks, courses, templates, and more directly to their audience, fostering a new era of financial independence.
NOWPayments slashes transaction fees, allowing you to keep more of your earnings.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The successful operation of a crypto payment gateway relies on various components working in tandem. First, there’s the hosting service, such as GitHub Pages, which serves the product listings. Next, the backend logic provided by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handles payment verification and product delivery. To store orders, creators can use Supabase or Google Sheets, ensuring that all sales data remains accessible. Finally, NOWPayments processes the cryptocurrency transactions, allowing users to pay in a range of digital currencies. Together, these elements create a cohesive system that supports creators in selling digital products efficiently.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your own crypto payment gateway for digital products, start by choosing a hosting platform, such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to handle transactions. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing, ensuring you select the right cryptocurrencies for your audience. Store order data in Supabase or Google Sheets, and configure your delivery system using Google Drive. Finally, test your setup thoroughly to ensure seamless operation. For a comprehensive solution, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) from COREMERCH, which provides all the necessary blueprints and templates.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Control your data and sales without relying on third-party platforms.

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online by using a crypto payment gateway like NOWPayments. This allows you to accept cryptocurrency payments and avoid the limitations of traditional processors. Set up a hosting platform, integrate the payment gateway, and deliver your ebook automatically.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?

The best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees is to utilize a self-hosted solution with a crypto payment gateway. This approach minimizes transaction fees and gives you complete control over your sales, unlike platforms that charge high fees on each transaction.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts by setting up your own online store using a combination of GitHub Pages, Google Apps Script, and NOWPayments. This method allows you to handle transactions independently and keep more of your earnings.
What are the fees associated with using NOWPayments?

NOWPayments charges a low fee of just 0.5% on transactions, making it significantly cheaper than traditional platforms like Gumroad, which can charge up to 10%. This fee structure enables creators to retain more income from their sales.
How do I ensure automatic delivery of my digital products?

To ensure automatic delivery of your digital products, use backend logic like Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to handle post-purchase processes. This automation allows customers to receive their purchased items immediately after payment confirmation.
